author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Mammoth facing left on HRECT_L: domed head with a hair notch and an eye, rounded back, two outlined legs with an arched gap, a long trunk to the foot line hooking at the tip, and a curved tusk hooking forward and up from the mouth; reads as a mammoth.
omissions: The ear curve (no room 8 from the eye and the back); the tusk is shortened to fit the 6 units left of the trunk.
